Page text:
 Programme 
 Everything on at the hall over the coming weeks. Times are door times. 

 Open Mic Comedy (http://127.0.0.1:48123/e/1) 
 Wed 23 Sep 2026, 7:00pm 
 Fixture Hall, 1 Example Street, West End 
 Five minutes each for anyone who signs up. Sign-up opens at 6:30pm at the bar; the running order is drawn from a hat. New acts are welcome and regulars are asked to bring new material. Booking is not required but the room fills on wet nights. 
 Free · Details and tickets (http://127.0.0.1:48123/e/1) 

 Repair Cafe (http://127.0.0.1:48123/e/2) 
 Thu 24 Sep 2026, 10:00am 
 Fixture Hall, 1 Example Street, West End 
 Bring a broken thing — a lamp, a jumper, a bike, a toaster — and sit with a volunteer who helps you fix it. Tools and common spare parts on the bench; sewing machines at the back. Under-18s welcome with an adult until 9pm. 
 Free · Details and tickets (http://127.0.0.1:48123/e/2) 

 Philosophy Reading Group (http://127.0.0.1:48123/e/3) 
 Fri 25 Sep 2026, 6:30pm 
 Fixture Hall, 1 Example Street, West End 
 This month the group reads the first half of Iris Murdoch's The Sovereignty of Good. No background needed; the discussion starts from the text and stays there. Part of the hall's spring programme; see the full list on this page. 
 $5 · Details and tickets (http://127.0.0.1:48123/e/3) 

 Life Drawing (untutored) (http://127.0.0.1:48123/e/4) 
 Sat 26 Sep 2026, 6:00pm 
 Fixture Hall, 1 Example Street, West End 
 Two hours with a live model, short poses first then two long ones. Easels and boards provided, bring your own paper and charcoal. Sixteen places. Ask at the bar about the concession rate. 
 $15 · Details and tickets (http://127.0.0.1:48123/e/4) 

 Jazz in the Hall (http://127.0.0.1:48123/e/5) 
 Sun 27 Sep 2026, 8:00pm 
 Fixture Hall, 1 Example Street, West End 
 The house quartet play two sets of standards with a guest horn player each month. Doors at 7:30pm, cabaret seating, licensed bar. Doors thirty minutes before the listed time. 
 $25 · Details and tickets (http://127.0.0.1:48123/e/5) 

 Board Game Library Night (http://127.0.0.1:48123/e/6) 
 Mon 28 Sep 2026, 6:00pm 
 Fixture Hall, 1 Example Street, West End 
 Three hundred games on the shelves and staff who will teach any of them. Tables for two to eight. Kitchen open until 9pm. Booking is not required but the room fills on wet nights. 
 Free · Details and tickets (http://127.0.0.1:48123/e/6) 

 Screen Printing Workshop (http://127.0.0.1:48123/e/7) 
 Tue 29 Sep 2026, 1:00pm 
 Fixture Hall, 1 Example Street, West End 
 Print your own tote or tee from a design you bring or one of ours. Covers stencil cutting, ink mixing and pulling a clean print. All materials included. Under-18s welcome with an adult until 9pm. 
 $45 · Details and tickets (http://127.0.0.1:48123/e/7) 

 Poetry Slam (http://127.0.0.1:48123/e/8) 
 Wed 30 Sep 2026, 7:30pm 
 Fixture Hall, 1 Example Street, West End 
 Eight poets, three rounds, one winner chosen by the room. Sign-up on the night; three-minute limit; no props, no music. Part of the hall's spring programme; see the full list on this page. 
 $10 · Details and tickets (http://127.0.0.1:48123/e/8) 

 Documentary Screening: The Weather Underground (http://127.0.0.1:48123/e/9) 
 Thu 1 Oct 2026, 7:00pm 
 Fixture Hall, 1 Example Street, West End 
 The 2002 film about the 1970s American radical group, followed by a discussion led by a local historian. Ask at the bar about the concession rate. 
 $8 · Details and tickets (http://127.0.0.1:48123/e/9) 

 Beginners' Ceramics (http://127.0.0.1:48123/e/10) 
 Fri 2 Oct 2026, 10:30am 
 Fixture Hall, 1 Example Street, West End 
 Hand-building only: pinch pots, coils and slabs. Pieces are fired and ready to collect a fortnight later. Aprons provided. Doors thirty minutes before the listed time. 
 $60 · Details and tickets (http://127.0.0.1:48123/e/10)

 Sat 3 Oct 2026, 7:00pm 
 Fixture Hall, 1 Example Street, West End

 $5 · Details and tickets (http://127.0.0.1:48123/e/11)

Source: Fixture Venue

Page text:
Gig Guide — Fixture Venue 

 Gig Guide 
 Live music and other nights at the venue. Tickets at the door unless noted. 
 The Quiet Ones Fri 25 Sep 2026, 8:00pm Slowcore trio launching their second record, recorded over a winter in a Tasmanian shed; support from a solo pedal-steel set. Doors 7:30pm, standing room in the band room, seats in the front bar. $20 
 Comedy Wednesdays Wed 23 Sep 2026, 7:30pm Six acts and an MC in the back room every Wednesday. The line-up is announced on the day; the first Wednesday of the month is a new-material night. $10 
 Sunday Session: Folk Club Sun 27 Sep 2026, 3:00pm Acoustic open floor in the beer garden, sign up at the bar from 2:30pm. Free 
 Trivia Tuesday Tue 29 Sep 2026, 7:00pm Eight rounds, teams of up to six, bar tab for the winners. Free 
 Dub Night Sat 3 Oct 2026, 9:00pm Soundsystem in the courtyard, three selectors, late licence. $15 
 Songwriters in the Round Thu 8 Oct 2026, 7:30pm Four writers swap songs and stories on one stage. $12 
 Album Launch: Harbour Lights Sat 17 Oct 2026, 8:30pm Full band, a string quartet for the second set, and the record on vinyl at the merch desk. Two supports, both local, from 8pm. $25 
 Halloween Ball Sat 31 Oct 2026, 9:00pm Costume compulsory. Three bands upstairs, DJs in the courtyard until 3am, prizes at midnight. $30
